newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt to limit tax deductions on interest.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt to limit tax deductions on interest.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government would restrict tax deductability for interest paid by taxpayers to related parties.
"The thin capitalisation rules place a limit on the amount of interest expense payable to a related party that can be deducted for income tax purposes," Costello said in a statement.
"The thin capitalisation rules protect Australia's revenue base by ensuring that an appropriate amount of profit is derived in Australia."
He said the proposed amendments would take effect in the 1997/98 financial year, applying to all taxpayers from July 1.
He said the government planned to introduce the tax amendments into parliament in the next 10 days.
